description: This file defines a VideoPlayerProvider class that manages video playback state across the app. It handles video initialization, play, pause, mute, seek, expand/collapse, and disposal using Flutter's ChangeNotifier for state management and the video_player package.

classes.name: VideoPlayerProvider
classes.description: Provides app-wide state management for current video playback, including a mini player, controlling video playback, mute, expand, and loading states.

methods.name: _disposeController
methods.description: Safely disposes of the current video controller.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Starts playing a VideoItem, initializing the controller with network or asset video source.

methods.name: _onControllerUpdate
methods.description: Callback for controller updates to notify UI.

methods.name: seekTo
methods.description: Seeks video playback to a specified position.

methods.name: setExpanded
methods.description: Expands or collapses the video player UI.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops playback and resets the provider state.
